status.cancelBody: No problem — you can start anytime.

cancel.a: If you paid on the web, cancel from “Manage subscription” on this page. If you paid in the iPhone app (App Store), cancel in iPhone Settings > Apple ID > Subscriptions. You keep Premium until the paid period ends.

app.q: How is paying in the app different?
app.a: Same benefits. App store fees make the in-app price a little higher, so the web is cheaper. Wherever you pay, Premium opens on the web and in the app for the same account.

refund.a: Yes, within 7 days of your first payment (any plan, once per account) or of a yearly renewal — full amount. After 7 days there are no refunds, including partial refunds for unused time; canceling just stops the next renewal. Purchases in the iPhone app (App Store) are refunded by Apple.

data.q: Where does the data come from?
data.a: H-1B (LCA) and green card (PERM) filings published by the U.S. Department of Labor's Office of Foreign Labor Certification. They are filings, not hires or approved visas.

code.q: I have a code from my student association.
code.a: Tap “Have a code?” on this page (web) and enter it — Premium opens for free, no card needed. The app shows the same Premium. One code at a time.

policy.title: Subscription & refund policy

p: New members get a 7-day free trial with a card on file. Nothing is charged during the trial.
We remind you 3 days before the trial ends. Cancel before it ends and you won't be charged.
Premium renews automatically at the same interval (monthly, every 3 months, or yearly) until you cancel.
Cancel anytime in “Manage subscription” on the Premium page. After canceling you keep Premium until the end of the period you already paid for, and you won't be charged again.
For yearly plans, we email you 7 days before each renewal.
Within 7 days of your first payment, you can get a full refund for any plan (monthly, 3-month, or yearly). This is available once per account.
Within 7 days of a yearly renewal charge, you can get a full refund of that renewal.

After 7 days, payments are not refundable. We do not give partial or prorated refunds for unused time — for example, canceling 8 months into a yearly plan stops the next renewal and you keep Premium for the remaining 4 months, but no money is returned.
Double charges, payment errors, and long service outages on our side are always refunded in full.
When a refund is made, Premium ends immediately.
Email info@misaeng.com from your Misaeng account email with the date of the charge. We reply within 2 business days, and refunds go back to your original payment method (usually 5–10 business days).
Subscriptions bought in the iPhone app (App Store) are billed and refunded by Apple under its policies. Request a refund at reportaproblem.apple.com.
Premium opened with a free code is not refundable and ends on its own without any charge.

policy.note: This policy is part of our Terms of Use. If anything here conflicts with the law where you live, the law applies.
